author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸಾಧಿಸುವ ಛಲವಿರಲು ಬಂಧಗಳ ಚದುರಿಸುವೆ
ಆಧಿಗಳ ಮೆಟ್ಟಿದರೆ ಫಲವು ನಿನ್ನಕಡೆ
ವ್ಯಾಧಿಗಳು ತೊಡಕಾಗಿ ಮದ್ದುಗಳನರೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಆಧಿಪತ್ಯವು ನಿನದೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: With the grit to achieve, you will scatter your bonds;
tread down your anxieties, and the fruit comes your way;
when illnesses get in the way and you grind the medicines yourself,
the mastery is yours, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Determination breaks the chains that hold us. Overcome worry of the mind (ādhi) and meet illness of the body (vyādhi) with the right remedy, and you become master of your own life.
